retrievalProfile.description: A collage-style composition featuring a central figure against a textured wall overlaid with large, diagonal, translucent vinyl record shapes and cool-toned atmospheric lighting.

recipe.visualDefinition: A man in a light-colored suit stands against a rough-textured wall. The scene is dominated by large, overlapping, diagonal shapes resembling vinyl records that create a sense of rhythmic movement. The lighting is moody, with deep purples, blues, and highlights that emphasize the texture of the wall and the sheen of the records.
coreVisualRelationships: Diagonal repetition of circular record forms against a vertical human subject
High-contrast interplay between deep purple shadows and bright blue highlights
Rough wall texture visible through translucent graphic overlays
Top-aligned bold typography balancing the bottom-weighted subject
coreInvariants: Diagonal orientation of the record overlays

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A man stands in the lower right quadrant, scaled to approximately one-third of the vertical height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The largest diagonal record shape in the center-left provides the primary visual weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the diagonal records from top-left to bottom-right, landing on the human figure.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right and lower left corners provide breathing room through the textured wall.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep purple and indigo shadows in the background and record grooves.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright sky blue highlights on the record surfaces and wall.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm beige and white from the subject's clothing and the record labels.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with muted, atmospheric saturation levels.

letterConstructionRules: Strong italic slant to the right
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single family with weight and color variation for emphasis.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the clean, heavy, slanted aesthetic of the era.
Provides a similar industrial, bold feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a photo of a man in a light suit standing against a rough purple-textured wall, with large diagonal translucent vinyl records overlaid across the frame with blue highlights.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, italicized uppercase sans-serif text in the top right corner, using white for the first part and a muted gold for the second part.

verificationChecks: Are the records diagonal and translucent?
Is the wall texture visible through the overlays?
Is the text heavy, italicized, and top-aligned?
Is the color palette dominated by purple and blue?

postGenerationChecks: Check for diagonal flow from top-left to bottom-right
Ensure the man is positioned in the lower right
Verify the text is bold, italic, and uppercase
Confirm the presence of purple and blue color grading
